description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

The engineering intern position is for an individual contributor who is responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining significant systems that serve hundreds of millions of requests per month. Hiya provides high-availability, latency-sensitive capabilities to telecoms, mobile apps, and other partners. In addition, you'll work with engineering teams across Hiya, some in Seattle and some in Europe, to define and deliver shared components and services. From day one, you will be paired with a dedicated mentor who provides structured guidance, technical feedback, and ongoing career mentorship.

What You'll Do

Design, code, and operate high-performance services and data processing pipelines on a modern technology stack, supported by a structured technical crash course during your first two weeks covering our core tools, architecture, and repositories.

Work at a supportive and fast-growing startup with a fantastic team, where you can collaborate with and learn from other great team members.

Make an impact in the lives of hundreds of millions of consumers.

Be supported in developing your skills and accelerating your career.

What We Are Looking For

  • Engineering: CS majors - 2nd year (graduating 2028)

  • Excitement to work on innovative technology advancements

  • A philosophy of iteration and continuous improvement

  • Working knowledge of building services that adhere to operational SLAs

  • A preference for velocity over perfection

  • A commitment to respectful and impactful collaboration

  • Self-motivated and excited to learn about new technologies

Our Interview Process: The Hiya Voice AI Challenge

Once we’ve confirmed your eligibility, you’ll receive the Hiya Voice AI Challenge by email-- a chance to build a working prototype of a voice-driven product in one of five tracks: Accessibility, Productivity, Creative Voice, Security, or Real-Time Assistance. You’ll have one week to build it, with optional virtual office hours along the way if you’d like to pitch your idea and get steering from our team first.

From there:

  • Submit and get reviewed. One of our engineers reviews your work. If we’d like to explore your project further, you’ll get a link to book a 30-minute virtual session with an engineer or two-- a quick demo, a walkthrough of your code, and some questions.

  • Final interviews, in person at Hiya. Candidates who advance join us for a final round in London (2nd & 3rd of December): a debugging/fixing session, a chance to add a feature to your own project, and a conversation about Hiya’s values.

AI tools are welcome and encouraged the whole way through.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Dedicated technical mentorship with structured, regular feedback check-ins

  • Clear project scope and goals provided right at the start of your internship

  • Comprehensive onboarding to get you up to speed on Hiya's tooling, codebases, and systems quickly

  • A supportive, collaborative environment built on psychological safety and genuine impact

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.

You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience.

The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment.

  • Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

  • Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

  • Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.

  • Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

  • Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit.

  • Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.


    • What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions.

  • Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

  • An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong.

  • Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment

  • Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches.

  • Proven experimentation expertise, having designed and defended experiments with a clear view on decision frameworks and common failure modes.

  • Experience building analytical capability where none existed before, turning raw data and a business question into something a commercial team uses repeatedly.

  • Strong data modelling instincts, thinking in reusable definitions and single sources of truth rather than standalone analyses.

  • The ability to move comfortably between financial, product and operational data and connect the analysis to a financial outcome.

  • Genuine partnership instincts, translating between analytical rigour and commercial reality so that Commercial and Product come to you early rather than after the decision.

  • Fluency in the Python ML stack alongside strong SQL, with the engineering hygiene to hand over code that others can run and maintain.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors.

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and brings structure without waiting for permission.

  • Comfort using AI tools to augment analytical work, with a point of view on where they help and where they don't


    • Nice to have:

  • Experience in marketplace, telecom, travel, or subscription/usage-based businesses.

  • Bayesian or hierarchical modelling for sparse segments and long-tail SKUs.

  • Competitive price response modelling, or working with scraped competitor pricing data.

  • Familiarity with dbt, LightDash, or similar semantic/BI layers.

  • Experience designing semantic or metric layers consumed by both analytics and production systems.

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams spanning commercial, finance and product disciplines.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

 

Why we're hiring

Nous runs on small teams with real ownership and barely any middle management. That's a big part of how about 30 of us became one of the UK's fastest-growing startups. It also means the work of joining everything up has been spread across the founders and leads, squeezed in around their day jobs. Plans, OKRs, closing the hires that matter, the big company pushes: everyone does a bit of it and nobody owns it.

Last week showed what happens when someone does. We ran "crunch week": five days where most of the company dropped its normal work to relaunch Nous as a household agent. Twelve workstreams, one owner each, a short daily sync and a pre-mortem. In a week we rebuilt onboarding and the website, shipped new agent capabilities, and got legal, security and comms ready for launch. As one of the team said afterwards, when we cluster around a problem for a bit, we do loads of work.

We want that pace more of the time, without a founder having to drop everything to run it. So we're hiring a Chief of Staff.

 

About the role

You'll work directly with Greg (our CEO) and the founding team, and own how Nous runs day to day: the pace, planning and OKRs, and the big company pushes, plus overseeing hiring and helping land the hires that matter most. You'll sit in the management meeting and get the full picture, including the things that aren't public yet. And you'll have the authority to change how we work: cancel or reshape meetings, and move people and cut scope during a big push.

You enjoy coordinating, but only because it gets things done faster. You'd rather get a decision made today than design a process for making decisions.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Set the pace. Spot what's stuck, work out why, and get it moving. Usually it's a decision nobody has made yet, so you get it made, or make it yourself.

  • Own planning and OKRs. Quarterly OKRs, the weekly management meeting, planning and offsites. Squads run pretty autonomously; you make sure they're working to the same priorities. Each of these should take up less of everyone's time with you running it, not more.

  • Own the scorecard. Keep the numbers behind our OKRs current, and say each week what's off track and why. You pull the data yourself (SQL, our BI tool, a spreadsheet) rather than chasing people for updates.

  • Run the big pushes. The next crunch week is yours: scope it with the leadership team, pick the owners, run it, and write up what we'd do differently next time.

  • Oversee hiring, and help close the hires that matter. Hiring managers run their own processes, and you won't be running ten of them. But you'll keep an eye on all of them, know where every search stands, and jump in where needed. Mostly that's closing the people we really want: working out what they care about and how to win them. Sometimes it's getting a recruiter excited about working with Nous, or unsticking a process that's gone quiet.

  • Represent Nous. You'll talk to recruiters and senior candidates from day one. Over time, and where it helps, you'll represent us to partners, suppliers and investors too.

  • Automate the boring bits. You'd rather build the Monday status digest with Claude than write it by hand every week. Anything you find yourself doing every week is a candidate for automating.

 

What this role isn't

  • An assistant. Diaries and inboxes are someone else's job.

  • A process role. If your first instinct is a new meeting, template or tracker, this probably won't suit you. With you here we should have fewer recurring meetings, not more.

  • A product role. Squads own what gets built, and strategy stays with the founders. You'll be in the room for both, and you make sure nobody's blocked.

  • A recruiter. You oversee hiring and step in where it matters; hiring managers still run their own processes.

  • A dumping ground for jobs nobody else wants. You'll pick up odd jobs, as everyone here does, but the bulk of the role is above.

 

What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

  • The company runs noticeably better: decisions get made faster and fewer things stall. Ask the leads and they'd say so.

  • Something that had been stuck for weeks has shipped because you got involved.

  • You've helped close at least one hire we really wanted.

  • Next quarter's OKRs are set, and the scorecard is current every week.

  • At least one piece of weekly coordination (the OKR update, the status round-up) runs as an AI workflow you built, and nobody does it by hand any more.

  • We have fewer recurring meetings than when you joined.

After a year:

  • You've led two or three company-wide pushes that shipped what they set out to.

  • The senior hires you helped close have said yes and are doing well.

  • Planning, OKRs and the weekly meetings run fine for a month without you.

  • Most of the routine coordination runs on workflows and tools you built, not on meetings.

 

About you

You've got 4–7 years behind you (perhaps a little more if you've switched careers), probably a mix of a fast-growing startup and somewhere that taught you structure: consulting, BizOps or strategy and ops at a scale-up, a founder's office, or product work where you ran launches across teams. Maybe you've founded something.

You coordinate because you're impatient. You notice the thing that's been stuck for a week, and you're the one who unsticks it.

You're persuasive. You can work out what a candidate is really optimising for and how to close them, get a busy recruiter excited about Nous, and hold your own with senior people outside the company.

You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a quick model, write a bit of SQL or find the right dashboard, and tell a real trend from noise.

AI tooling is already how you work. Claude, Claude Code or similar is where you get things done, not something you tried once.

You write clearly and quickly. Most of this job happens in writing: kick-off notes, weekly updates, closing emails.

You tell people the truth, founders included, and you keep confidences. You'll see salaries, plans and people issues before anyone else does.

You listen and you care, but you don't do politics. This role has more connective tissue with others than anyone else in the business, so by playing it straight and being an honest broker, you are also establishing an important norm.

Low ego. Some of the job is unglamorous and you do it anyway.

Bonus points:

  • You've closed hard candidates, or worked in recruiting, talent or BD.

  • You've run a company planning cycle, an offsite or a launch end to end.

  • You've worked somewhere regulated (energy, fintech, insurance).

  • You've automated a chunk of your own job and have something to show for it.

  • You are commercially astute or professionally experienced in a deep domain like law or accounting.

 

How you will grow

This might not be a forever role, and that's fine. You'll see more of how a fast-growing company works than almost anyone else here, which tends to open doors: running a new category as we expand, leading a function, or a commercial or operations role. Or the role grows with the company. Either way, we'll talk about it properly once you've been here a year.

 

Remuneration and benefits

Compelling packages, including share options with life-changing upside. We've raised enough money to pay real salaries. We're building something great together and we all share in the upside. If we win, we win together.

An environment where you can do your best work:

  • 🏢 A great office set up for lots of collaborative working. We already need more whiteboards

  • 💻 The equipment / setup / training you need to do your best work (and of course, AI subscriptions, including Claude Code Max tier)

  • 🤝 A high-context environment with lots of exposure to the big decisions - be in the room when it happens (literally)

  • 🏡 Flexibility around remote work. If you sometimes just need to get your head down, that's fine

  • ☕ Very good coffee

  • 🍽️ A well-stocked kitchen (featuring a wildly popular toastie maker) so you can always make yourself a breakfast or light lunch on the house

  • 🎉 Informal social every week, something bigger every month, plus a set-piece event in the summer and again at Christmas - we're not robots!

  • ✈ 33 days paid holidays (including bank holidays)

  • 💊 Health and dental cash plans, including an employee assistance programme

  • 🚴 Travel benefits, including the cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans

Nous has an office-first culture. That means we encourage in-person working, and most people do work from the office in Farringdon most of the time. We do a lot of brainstorming, problem-solving and interaction within the team and presence makes this more effective. It also helps ensure people have good peripheral awareness and high context. But we are pragmatic not doctrinal about this, and recognise that, sometimes, certain types of work can be better done remotely. Most team members spend 3-4 days a week in the office on average. This role may naturally involve even more presence than that.

 

The environment

Most importantly, this is a high-performance, high-agency and high-trust technical environment. Nous is intentionally lean and AI-native, not just in its product but as a company. Everyone is expected to use AI to its full potential, whether that's debugging a system, streamlining a workflow or improving how customers are served. Rather than building layers of middle management, we hire smart, high-agency people and give them real ownership.

We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace, and we actively welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Every candidate is thoughtfully considered, without regard to race, religion, gender expression, disability or sexual orientation.

If you don't tick every box but think you'd be great at this, get in touch anyway.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

 

How we build (worth reading before the role)

How products get built is changing fast. With AI tooling, a PM can prototype, dig into production data and commit production code to get a change live all in an afternoon. An engineer can own a product area end to end and decide what to build next.

We're leaning into that. Our PMs lean into code and our engineers run products: one of our engineers owns the car insurance targets. We care about whatever gets the job done most effectively, regardless of once upon a time whose job it was meant to be.

We're moving fast and adapting as we go, and we don't have all the answers yet. What should a squad look like when everyone can build? Where does process still help, and where does it just slow you down? What's a PM for when an engineer can run the experiment themselves? We're working it out, and we want someone who is excited to be part of helping figure it out.

 

About the role

So where does a PM fit? A lot of our work still suits squads: clear targets, a few service lines and a team of engineers. Those squads need product managers to run them. All our roles in product overlap, but this one is centred on product management. If you’d rather spend all your time building, have a look at our Product Builder role.

You’ll take a squad responsible for a key section of our product and service lines and grow them: expand what they cover, understand the levers that drive their performance (automation, new suppliers, what we recommend to members) and increase their commercial value.

Being a Product Manager at Nous is one of the hardest roles we have. The product is complex and we move fast, so you need to be able to hold a lot of context. You'll switch between very different things all day: thinking about OKRs and the plan for the next couple of weeks one moment, getting a PR into production the next, while helping unblock an engineer.

That's also what makes it exciting.

You bring order to fast-moving work, get some sequencing in place so people aren’t each figuring it out on their own, evaluate what’s being shipped, own the reporting and keep the squad’s energy up. You won’t hesitate to make changes yourself, but you won’t be just another builder in the squad either: when you’re heads-down building, you can’t unblock anyone or bring the team together.

Growing a service line here means working across the boundary between product and commercial, so we’re particularly interested in PMs who’ve had real exposure to the commercial side of a business.

Our agent acts in the real world a lot, so saving someone money takes more than great product execution. We also need access to the best tariffs and suppliers, and we have to understand the regulation we operate in. And because Nous is an agent, your nice neat Amplitude funnels don't work: every user's journey can be totally different. So we're after PMs who are excited by everything it takes to make an agentic product work for real households, including the bits that wouldn't traditionally count as "product".

Worth being upfront: we can't tell you yet which service lines you'd own. It depends on the Venn diagram of your particular skill set and the problems we need to solve at the point you join.

 

What matters most

We need all of these at once:

  • Sharp. You pick things up quickly and enjoy hard problems. Given a messy one, you can lay out what you know and what you'd check first, then change your mind as new data turns up.

  • Adaptable. We’re working a lot of this out as we go, so the role and the squad will change, probably more than once. You enjoy that. You pick up whatever’s needed, PM work or not, and you work in the open: sharing rough thinking early and changing course when someone has a better idea.

  • Delivery. You bring order to a fast-moving squad: clear priorities, sensible sequencing, people unblocked quickly, and an honest look at whether what shipped actually worked.

  • Product craft. You find the real problem behind a request and make the trade-offs explicit. You care about the details of what our users actually see.

  • Commercial and analytical. You know what your area made last month, what moved it and what you'd do next, and you answer most of your own questions with data. You think in conversion, margin and lifetime value as readily as in features.

  • Energy. You've probably worked at a startup. You move fast, you're happy doing the unglamorous work yourself, and you'd rather ship this week's version than polish next quarter's.

And everyone builds here, PMs included. You'll use AI tooling (Claude Code or whatever gets it done) to prototype, dig into data and ship changes yourself. You don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be scared of code.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Grow your service lines. Understand what really drives their performance, be able to measure it, and lead the squad to deliver it.

  • Set the squad's OKRs and roadmap, get the sequencing in place, and drive fast, efficient execution.

  • Evaluate what’s being shipped, and own the reporting: make sure the reports and the data behind them make sense.

  • Work across product and commercial: the suppliers and tariffs we can offer, the regulation we work within, and what that means for what gets built.

  • Run experiments, and unblock yourself on the analysis without always needing an analyst.

  • Get close to members and ops. Read the conversations, sit with the people handling the edge cases, and fix the parts of the journey where people drop out or get stuck.

 

About you

You'll likely thrive here if:

  • You've been a PM for a few years, ideally at a startup, and you've owned something with a number attached: revenue, conversion, retention.

  • You've worked on the commercial side as well as the product side: a P&L, a supplier or partner relationship, pricing, or a whole service line.

  • You're comfortable enough with data and code to unblock yourself.

Nice-to-haves:

  • You were a software engineer before you moved into product.

  • You've worked on a transactional or regulated product: insurance, fintech, energy, marketplaces.

  • You've built and shipped your own thing: a startup, a side project, an internal tool that took off.

This probably isn't for you if your PM experience is mostly roadmaps and stakeholder management at a big company, with no number you owned.

 

How we work

We keep the middle thin, on purpose. There's barely any middle management, which means fewer bottlenecks and room for exceptional people to have real impact without first being promoted into managing others. The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer.

Founded by Aymeric (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.

France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service.

Pelagon is backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised.

 

Why this matters

The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem.

France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our Acoustic Researcher, you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define.

What you'll do

  • Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline.

  • Characterize and classify acoustic signatures of surface and underwater targets; build the ground-truth understanding our multimodal acoustic model is trained against.

  • Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors.

  • Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models.

What we look for

  • Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience.

  • Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theory, array processing, time-frequency analysis.

  • Fluent in Python (NumPy/SciPy) for modeling, simulation and analysis; comfortable working with large datasets.

  • A builder's instinct, you want your work deployed at sea, not left in a paper. Bias toward validating ideas against real data.

  • Bonus: prior experience using machine learning on acoustic signals, naval / defense domain experience.

 

Why join now

  • Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that.

  • A mission with weight. This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space.

  • Real things, in the real ocean, fast. You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years.

  • AI-first, at the edge, in the real world. We train our own models and run them where it counts: in the water, on the device. You'll be solving the edge-ML and power problems most companies only talk about.

  • A sovereign, European deeptech at the inflection point of a market with strong NATO and EU policy momentum behind it.

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer

Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? Krijg jij energie van het organiseren van complexe technische projecten en vind je het leuk om verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service.

Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd.

Je taken omvatten onder andere:

• Overnemen en structureren van projecten na opdracht, inclusief scope, specificaties, planning, budget en risico’s
• Vertalen van klant- en contracteisen naar duidelijke technische specificaties en werkpakketten

title: Junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames
description:
Ben jij het zonnetje in huis? En heb jij al affiniteit met de wereld van bedrijfsovernames?

Lees dan vooral verder! Wij zoeken namelijk een junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames. Je bent - samen met een senior collega - verantwoordelijk voor het gehele overnameproces van MKB bedrijven.

Wat is je takenpakket?

  • Je onderhoud korte lijnen met jouw klant (de ondernemer die zijn bedrijf gaat verkopen). Die voelt dat jij aan z’n kant staat.

We hebben specialisten op elk gebied van het bedrijfsovernameproces; waardebepalingen, juridische afwikkeling en het informeren van geïnteresseerden. Dit is dus allemaal al geregeld en hoeft dus niet alles zelf te doen. Ondanks dat dit niet bij jouw verantwoordelijkheden hoort, krijg je hier wel alles van mee. We werken namelijk als een team. Mocht je ervaring en interesse hier liggen, dan kunnen we je takenpakket hiermee uitbreiden.


Wie is onze ideale kandidaat?

  • Je hebt affiniteit met overname processen

  • Je communiceert op een natuurlijke en informele wijze met diverse partijen

  • Je hebt affiniteit hebt met cijfers en je kunt uit de voeten met jaarrekeningen en financiële rapportages

  • Je vind het leuk jezelf te verplaatsen in MKB ondernemers uit diverse sectoren en van allerlei niveau’s

  • Je hebt overredingskracht en geeft tegengas aan je klant wanneer het nodig is

  • Je hebt een winnaarsmentaliteit en gaat daarvoor graag “the extra mile”

  • Je kunt gemakkelijk tussen cases schakelen: bij een fulltime dienstverband werk je doorgaans aan 10-15 cases tegelijkertijd

Over Take 5

Over het algemeen zijn ondernemers ongeduldige mensen. Het liefst is alles gisteren al gebeurd. Wij kennen het overnameproces. We zijn hierin deskundig en ervaren. Dat wil zeggen: we hebben alle expertise in huis om een MKB’er zo goed mogelijk mee te nemen en we doen dit al een hele tijd.

Het verkopen van een bedrijf doen MKB ondernemers maximaal 1-2 keer in hun leven. Ze staan hun kindje af. Dit is een emotioneel en spannend proces. Wij zijn toegewijd en pro-actief. We zijn streng op de kwalificatie en nemen alleen genoegen met het beste voor de ondernemer.

We zijn authentiek en gelijkwaardig. Dat wil zeggen: we gaan naast een ondernemer staan en nemen die stap voor stap mee. We gebruiken ons karakter en eigenaardigheden om de connectie met de ondernemer te maken. Hoe lekkerder je zelf in je vel zit, hoe beter je iemand kunt helpen.



Wat wij je bieden

  • Een hecht team waar jouw werk direct zichtbaar impact heeft

  • Een omgeving waar keihard werken en keihard lachen hand in hand gaat

  • De ruimte om te mogen zijn wie je bent

  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid en geen hiërarchisch gedoe

  • Ruimte om te groeien in wat je nog niet kan maar wel wil leren

  • Een werkomgeving waar ‘doen waar je energie van krijgt’ het aller-belangrijkste is

  • Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden, daar komen we uit

Belangrijk om te weten: voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die in loondienst komt. Daar tegenover staat dat je alle verantwoordelijkheden en voordelen krijgt die horen bij ondernemerschap. In de kern hebben wij geen programma om mede-eigenaar te worden. Mochten we er samen, na jarenlange gebleken geschiktheid, achter komen dat dit wel de juiste koers is, dan kan het alsnog. Dit is echter niet het initiële doel bij indiensttreding.

Wat we zoeken

Of je nu starter bent of ervaren: wie je bent is belangrijker dan wat je kunt. De wil om keihard gas te geven en dat met een enorme lach is het belangrijkst.

Klaar om samen met ons op avontuur te gaan? Wil je samen met ons een van de belangrijkste stappen voor ondernemers waarmaken, en zelf óók groeien? Dan kunnen we niet wachten om van je te horen.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
Over NovoServe

NovoServe levert hosted dedicated servers vanuit meerdere datacenters in Nederland. We zijn een snelgroeiend bedrijf met een informele sfeer en internationale ambities. We zetten fors in op automatisering, om snel te kunnen opschalen en onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen. Om onze snelle groei mogelijk te maken, ontwikkelen we eigen systemen voor IaaS-dienstverlening. Wij beheren een internationaal netwerk dat meer dan 7.000 fysieke servers ondersteunt, 19 Tbps aan externe connectiviteit biedt en beschikt over tientallen peering-partners. Onze netwerkinfrastructuur is verspreid over 8 datacenters op twee continenten, wat zorgt voor een hoge beschikbaarheid, veerkracht en een wereldwijd bereik.

Kern van de functie

Als Procurement Specialist ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige inkoopproces voor onze servers en netwerkapparatuur: van de behoefte-inventarisatie tot en met het contractbeheer. Je werkt op internationaal niveau voor onze datacenters in Nederland, de Verenigde Staten en Denemarken.

Je onderhoudt en versterkt duurzame relaties met onze belangrijkste leveranciers en blijft op de hoogte van nieuwe, opkomende spelers.

Je neemt het voortouw in de leveranciersselectie en het contracteringsproces. Hierbij zorg je niet alleen voor de beste commerciële voorwaarden, maar waarborg je ook dat alle afspraken voldoen aan de actuele wet- en regelgeving en onze langetermijnstrategie.

Naast inkoop ben je de drijvende kracht achter ons contractmanagement. Je beheert het contractregister waardoor we tijdig kunnen besluiten te verlengen of juist over te stappen naar een andere leverancier.

Dit doe je niet alleen; je werkt nauw samen met interne stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat de inkoop perfect aansluit op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Samen met Portfolio management signaleer je markt- en prijsontwikkelingen en risico's, en neem je passende maatregelen. Daarnaast organiseer je samen met interne deskundigen periodieke leveranciersbeoordelingen, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, risicobeheersing en commerciële prestaties.

Hier herken jij jezelf in:

title: Tender Manager
description:
Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Wil jij als Business Development Manager de vrijheid krijgen om nieuwe kansen en markten te ontdekken en jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk tot leven te brengen? Bij Adapteo krijg je in deze rol de kans waarbij ondernemerschap, duurzame groei en internationale ambities samenkomen. Vanuit Klundert bouw je aan nieuwe proposities en creëer je kansen binnen uiteenlopende sectoren. Een vacature voor een gedreven commerciële professional die graag pioniert en klantbehoeften achterhaalt.

Maak het verschil als Business Development Manager in Nederland

Dankzij jouw marktkennis, inzicht en commerciële nieuwsgierigheid ontdekt Adapteo nieuwe groeimogelijkheden en vertaalt de organisatie maatschappelijke en economische ontwikkelingen naar concrete business. Je onderzoekt markten, identificeert kansrijke klantsegmenten en gaat actief in gesprek met bestaande en potentiële klanten en beslissers. Vervolgens vertaal je inzichten samen met accountmanagers, marketing, product development en andere interne collega’s naar proposities, campagnes en een gerichte marktbenadering. Je kwalificeert opportunities en ondersteunt bij grote of complexe klanttrajecten. De rol is landelijk en bestaat indicatief voor 60% uit binnenwerk en 40% uit activiteiten in de markt. Zo combineer je analyse en strategie met persoonlijk contact en commerciële actie.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en identificeren van nieuwe sectoren, klantsegmenten en commerciële kansen;

  • ontwikkelen van concepten, proposities, campagnes en marktbenaderingen;

  • initiëren van gesprekken met bestaande en potentiële klanten en relevante beslissers;

  • kwalificeren, structureren en overdragen van business opportunities aan Accountmanagers;

  • delen van marktinzichten en trainen van het salesteam rondom commerciële concepten of aanpak van bepaalde afzetmarkten.

Als enthousiaste Business Development Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Veel eigenaarschap binnen een organisatie met Europese groeiambities. Je krijgt ruimte om te pionieren, ideeën te ontwikkelen en jezelf en de organisatie verder te ontwikkelen. Vanuit deze positie kun je doorgroeien richting operationele aansturing, een rol als branchespecialist of mogelijk een internationale functie.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • bruto jaarsalaris tot €84.000,-;

  • bonusregeling;

  • 32 vakantiedagen + 15 ATV dagen

  • pensioenregeling via BPF Bouw;

  • telefoon, laptop, en een elektrische leaseauto;

  • onderdeel van de CAO Timmerindustrie;

  • doorgroeimogelijkheden of opleidingstrajecten.

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar markten en mensen en stelt vragen waarmee je de werkelijke behoefte boven tafel krijgt. Je combineert analytisch en conceptueel denkvermogen met sterke relationele vaardigheden. Dankzij jouw structuur houd je meerdere opportunities en campagnes tegelijk overzichtelijk. Je neemt initiatief, brengt ideeën in en weet marktinformatie terug te brengen tot een concrete commerciële aanpak.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële rol en consultative selling;

  • ervaring met projectmatige trajecten;

  • analytisch sterk, waardoor je kansen en prioriteiten goed kunt monitoren;

  • behoeften en wensen vertalen naar conceptuele oplossingen;

  • ervaring met het onderzoeken en opbouwen van nieuwe marktsegmenten;

  • uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw standplaats is Klundert en vanuit daar richt je je op kansen door heel Nederland. Je verdeelt je tijd tussen kantoor, thuiswerken en afspraken bij (potentiële) klanten. Regelmatig reizen binnen Nederland hoort daardoor bij de baan en incidenteel kan een internationale reis voorkomen. Adapteo zoekt bij voorkeur iemand die binnen circa 50 kilometer van Klundert woont.

Werken bij Adapteo

title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals:

  • Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten;
  • Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren);
  • Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie;
  • Hartkleplijden.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend.

De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie.

Over ons: onze zorg klopt!

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol.

We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog.

Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen);
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende:

  • Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW;
  • Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht;
  • 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer;
  • Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past;
  • Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. En voordeel op jouw ziektekostenverzekering met onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

title: HR Business Partner
description:

Taken

Maak het verschil als HR Business Partner in Zwolle

Dankzij jouw brede HR-expertise krijgen leidinggevenden een stevige sparringpartner en ontwikkelt HR mee met de ambities van de organisatie. Als HR Business Partner adviseer je zelfstandig jouw klantgroepen over strategische, tactische én operationele HR-vraagstukken. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen organisatieontwikkeling, verandertrajecten en concrete personeelscasuïstiek. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en vertaal je ideeën naar concrete verbeteringen. Je werkt nauw samen met de HR Manager en andere HR-collega’s en hebt veel contact met leidinggevenden binnen onder meer Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf en Mooij Verf. Ook zet je HR en financiële data gericht in om keuzes te onderbouwen en pak je zelfstandig projecten op rondom thema’s als Strategische personeelsinzet, medewerker ontwikkeling, duurzame inzetbaarheid en organisatie- en teamontwikkeling. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • adviseren en ondersteunen van leidinggevenden bij strategische, tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken;
  • begeleiden van organisatieontwikkeling en verandertrajecten;
  • zelfstandig initiëren en realiseren van HR-projecten rondom onder andere strategische HR, ontwikkeling en duurzame inzetbaarheid;
  • analyseren van HR-data en vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen en verbeteringen;
  • professionaliseren van HR-processen en versterken van de brede inzetbaarheid binnen het HR-team.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je combineert gevoel voor wat belangrijk is voor de organisatie met de durf om stelling te nemen. Daardoor weet je wanneer je moet luisteren, doorvragen of duidelijk positie moet innemen. Je voelt je thuis in een ondernemende omgeving en krijgt energie van het daadwerkelijk realiseren van verbeteringen. Daarbij schakel je soepel tussen verschillende belangen, persoonlijkheden en organisatieniveaus. Data gebruik je om gesprekken en beslissingen inhoudelijk te versterken.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • een afgeronde bacheloropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in HRM of bedrijfskunde;
  • minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen een brede HR-functie;
  • ervaring met projectmanagement, changemanagement en organisatieontwikkeling;
  • Excelvaardigheden, waaronder het zelfstandig werken met draaitabellen;
  • ervaring binnen een familiebedrijf is een pré.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf in Zwolle. Vanuit deze locatie ondersteunt HR de volledige organisatie, waaronder ook de vestigingen van Mooij Verf in het land. Het kantoor is goed bereikbaar via de A28 en vanuit plaatsen als Kampen, Meppel, Apeldoorn, Deventer en Raalte. Bij een fulltime werkweek is thuiswerken mogelijk. Tegelijkertijd is zichtbaarheid belangrijk: juist door regelmatig op locatie aanwezig te zijn, blijf je dicht bij leidinggevenden en medewerkers en weet je wat er binnen de organisatie speelt.

Benefits

Als gedreven HR Business Partner kun jij rekenen op:

Een veelzijdige HR-positie binnen een zelfstandig en duurzaam familiebedrijf dat investeert in duurzaamheid, innovatie én mensen. Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf geeft je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, ideeën om te zetten in resultaat en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een organisatie met korte lijnen.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een gegarandeerde eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;
  • 8% vakantietoeslag;
  • 29 vakantiedagen + 11,5 adv-dagen;
  • een dienstverband van 32, 36 of 40 uur per week;
  • de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken;
  • diverse trainings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;
  • personeelskorting op het assortiment.

Werken bij Koninklijke Van Wijhe Verf

title: Netwerk Engineer Telecom
description:
Over Maxitel

Bij Maxitel geloven ze dat zakelijke communicatie meer is dan alleen telefonie. Zij helpen organisaties met slimme oplossingen op het gebied van VoIP, mobiele telefonie, internet, glasvezel, IoT en connectiviteit. Daarbij leveren ze geen standaardproducten, maar maatwerk dat past bij de manier waarop hun klanten werken. Omdat Maxitel groeit en grotere klanten en projecten binnenhaalt, zoeken ze een Network Engineer die dit netwerk mee beheert en verder bouwt.

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

Als Network Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de techniek achter de diensten van Maxitel. Je werkt vanaf kantoor in Alphen aan den Rijn, nauw samen met de senior netwerkspecialist. Geen dag is hetzelfde.

Jouw werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

  • Beheren, configureren en uitbreiden van coreswitches en routers.
  • Onderhouden van het ringnetwerk en bewaken van de redundantie.
  • Aanvragen, inregelen en beheren van glasvezelverbindingen, in afstemming met leveranciers.
  • Inrichten en beheren van datacenterkoppelingen en peering, in afstemming met datacenters en partners.
  • Oplossen van storingen tot op de bodem, inclusief een structurele oplossing.
  • Meedenken over de architectuur van het netwerk nu Maxitel doorgroeit.
  • Documenteren van configuraties en netwerkschema's.
  • Oppakken van andere technische vraagstukken die op je pad komen, samen met collega's van support en sales.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken wij?

Maxitel zoekt een ervaren netwerkengineer die het netwerk echt begrijpt. Niet alleen hoe je iets instelt, maar ook waarom het werkt zoals het werkt. Je hebt dit al een aantal jaren gedaan en werkt zelfstandig. Wie een netwerk goed doorgrondt, pakt ook andere technische zaken makkelijk op. Die brede instelling zoeken ze.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt een aantal jaren ervaring als netwerkengineer, bij voorkeur bij een ISP, telecombedrijf of datacenter.
  • Je hebt stevige kennis van routing en switching: BGP, OSPF, VLAN's en bij voorkeur MPLS.
  • Je kent redundante netwerkontwerpen zoals ringtopologieën.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het configureren van apparatuur van bijvoorbeeld Cisco of Juniper.
  • Een certificering zoals CCNA, CCNP of JNCIA is mooi meegenomen.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en kunt de techniek overnemen als dat nodig is.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend. Engels is mooi meegenomen.

Benefits

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
